caption:
Costa Rica’s mountain trails rarely bother with switchbacks. When mountain biking in Costa Rica, the route often takes the most direct line—straight up the spine of the ridge where the grass is thick and wet with morning mist. At this altitude, the air cools and the dense canopy opens up to reveal valleys that stretch all the way to the horizon. It is a terrain that demands everything from your legs, but rewards you with a silence broken only by the wind and the quiet click of your freehub. You stop at the crest, not just to rest, but to realize how far you have come from the coast.
